title: Ways to live for 100 years
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Which matters more for living a long life: genetics, lifestyle, healthcare, or social relationships?
Would you want to live to 100 if you could not remain independent?
Why do some communities have unusually high numbers of very old people?
Should governments spend more on helping people live longer or on helping them stay healthier in old age?
What habit would you be willing to change today if you knew it could add several healthy years to your life?
